units.dwg: centimetre (INSUNITS=0; confirmed by level marks: 100 units = 1.00 m)

note: DWG model-space coordinates are a SHEET LAYOUT (all plans/sections/elevations placed side by side, ~845 m wide); they are not survey/geodetic coordinates. The model therefore uses a local origin; placing it on the TKI campus requires a site survey point or the campus base map.

local_origin.definition: intersection of structural grid axis 8 and axis A (grid shared by A block and B/C block)
local_origin.z0: +-0.00 project level (B/C ground floor finished level). A block ground floor = +1.00, natural ground in elevations = -1.00

plan_to_local.formula_A: local_m = R(+45 deg) * (P_dwg_cm - A8) / 100   (A block is rotated 45 deg CCW relative to B/C on site)

elevation_to_local.formula: elev_x_cm = c0 + 100 * dot(p_local_xy, r) ; elev_y_cm = zero + 100 * z

orientation.derived_from: elevation titles (no north arrow / grid north found in the DWG): DOGU = viewed from local +Y, KUZEY BATI from local (-X,-Y), GUNEY BATI from local (+X,-Y)

blender_axes: Blender Z-up, metres. GLB export uses glTF Y-up (+Y_gltf = +Z_blender). FBX: unit scale applied (metres).
